mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average signals an expanding economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 3% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 3-month moving average signals an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of industrial production growth above its 3-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of joint growth in housing starts and consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 2% and an increase in the money supply trigger an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 2% and the money supply is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of joint growth in employment and decline in the unemployment rate (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above its 6-month moving average and a decrease in the federal funds rate trigger an increase in economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when industrial production is above its 6-month moving average and the federal funds rate is below 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
